scenes.voice: A user taps pay twice. Do you charge them twice? Not if you use an idempotency key.
The client sends a unique key with the request. The server stores that key with the result of the first attempt.
If the same key shows up again, return the saved result. Don't run the charge a second time.
That makes retries safe after a timeout, when the client can't tell if the first request worked.
Expire old keys after a while. Save this for the next time you build a payment endpoint.
